##### Project general facts

Al Thuraya Island delivers a distinguished portfolio of villas alongside expansive eight‑bedroom mansions, each crafted with a harmonious marriage of sleek modern lines and enduring traditional motifs. The architecture showcases generous living spaces, floor‑to‑ceiling windows and open‑plan layouts that flood interiors with natural light while framing uninterrupted vistas of lush gardens and serene waters. Every residence benefits from thoughtfully positioned balconies that blur the boundaries between indoor comfort and the surrounding seascape.  

The development equips each mansion with a private swimming pool, an intimate home theatre and a dedicated wellness centre, creating an enclave of personal indulgence. State‑of‑the‑art kitchens serve the culinary ambitions of families residing in the villas, while the mansions’ exclusive amenities reinforce an atmosphere of refined privacy. Communal design elements such as landscaped terraces enhance the sense of open, airy living throughout the enclave.  

Interiors feature modern finishing with high‑quality materials, establishing a cohesive aesthetic of understated elegance. Kitchens arrive fully equipped, ready to support effortless cooking experiences. No pre‑installed furnishings are provided, allowing owners the freedom to personalize their spaces.  

##### Location description and benefits

Al Hamriya unfolds as a vibrant quarter of Sharjah, perched along the picturesque Arabian Gulf coastline and celebrated for its peaceful ambience. The district intertwines historic charm with contemporary conveniences, presenting a balanced lifestyle for residents and visitors alike. Its strategic position within the emirate ensures easy connectivity to neighboring urban centres.  

Traditional architecture graces the streets of Al Hamriya, where bustling local markets and lively community events echo the rich Emirati heritage. Several heritage sites dot the area, offering glimpses into the region’s storied past. These cultural landmarks foster a deep sense of identity and pride among the community.  

The shoreline bordering Al Hamriya boasts some of Sharjah’s most tranquil beaches, where powder‑soft sands meet clear, inviting waters. Visitors delight in activities ranging from swimming and sunbathing to picnicking and energetic beach sports. Scenic coastal promenades provide an ideal setting for leisurely strolls and cherished family outings.
